title: Ordinary etale finite-simplex lifting
statement: Let X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and V an etale hypercover [def-weil-pbc-etale-hypercover]. Let A be a finite subcomplex of Delta[n], nonempty in every degree. For any etale T over X and any compatible family T to V_m indexed by simplices of A, there is an etale covering T_i to T and maps g_i:T_i to V_n whose restrictions to every simplex of A are the pullbacks of that family.

source.place: Tag 01GN (lemma-add-simplices), local-lifting clause, with singleton representables

proof.text: The canonical matching comparison makes V after singleton inclusion a semi-representable hypercover. The standard simplex family on its degree n object is a representing universal family.

Represent the finite A-family functor by its Hom object. Its universal family gives a bijection between points of this representing object and compatible families. Send the given ordinary family to its singleton-included representing point.

Apply the local-lifting clause of finite-simplex lifting to that point. Evaluation of the representing restriction identity at any A-simplex identifies its restricted lifted family with the pulled-back original family. Full faithfulness of singleton inclusion converts the maps to the claimed ordinary etale maps.

lean.statement:
theorem locally_extend_simplex {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (V : SimplicialObject X.Etale) (hV : IsEtaleHypercover V) (n : ℕ)
    (A : (Δ[n] : SSet.{t}).Subcomplex) [A.toSSet.Finite]
    (hAnonempty : ∀ m : ℕ, Nonempty (A.toSSet.obj (op ⦋m⦌))) (T : X.Etale)
    (f : ∀ m : ℕ, A.toSSet.obj (op ⦋m⦌) → (T ⟶ V.obj (op ⦋m⦌)))
    (hf : ∀ (m k : ℕ) (φ : ⦋m⦌ ⟶ ⦋k⦌) (s : A.toSSet.obj (op ⦋k⦌)),
      f k s ≫ V.map φ.op = f m (A.toSSet.map φ.op s)) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (Tc : ι → X.Etale) (p : ∀ c : ι, Tc c ⟶ T),
      Sieve.ofArrows Tc p ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology T ∧
        ∃ g : ∀ c : ι, Tc c ⟶ V.obj (op ⦋n⦌),
          ∀ (c : ι) (m : ℕ) (s : A.toSSet.obj (op ⦋m⦌)),
            g c ≫ V.map (SSet.stdSimplex.objEquiv s.val).op = p c ≫ f m s
